guidance: Planning estimate—verify assumptions and important results before committing time or money.
method: Deterministic arithmetic on strictly parsed positive numbers. Volume per piece = length x width x depth for a rectangular mold, pi x (diameter / 2)^2 x depth for a round mold, or length x width x thickness for a coating; inches convert at 2.54 cm and coating thickness at 25.4 mm. Total mix = per-piece volume x pieces x (1 + margin / 100). Resin and hardener volumes are split by the selected parts ratio (part / total parts), with every ratio treated as parts by volume. No allowance is made for density, weight-based ratios, product-specific maximum pour depth or exotherm behaviour, film left in the cup beyond the entered margin, or shrinkage.
